thread:
Mira Patel: quick heads-up — planning to onboard model-lite-2.0 into the catalog tomorrow morning during the quiet window (09:30 PT). need an owner for smoke & rollback readiness.
Sam Nguyen: I can own smoke checks. what traffic % for canary?
Mira Patel: start 10% canary for 10m, smoke script runs loadgen at 50 qps. if green, promote to 50% for 15m then 100%. pin policy: we'll pin `catalog:model-lite:2.0` (no alias).
Jon Reyes: where's the smoke script? drop the command and I'll sanity-check it.
Sam Nguyen: here's the one-liner i use:
```bash
./smoke.sh --model catalog:model-lite:2.0 --qps 50 --duration 600
```
Sam Nguyen: smoke checks to verify p95 latency < 300ms, error_rate < 0.5% and KV cache hit ratio > 80%
Carla Ortiz: I'll create alerts: p95>350ms, error_rate>1% to trigger paging. also adding a dashboard tab for the canary.
Mira Patel: rollback plan: `catalog swap --from catalog:model-lite:2.0 --to catalog:model-lite:1.9` and route traffic back to pinned v1.9. infra folks — any blocking infra work in that window? @infra-bot
infra-bot: no maintenance scheduled in the 09:00-11:00 PT window. reserve node pool for canary? ask noted.
Jon Reyes: quick note on model size — quantized variant will be used, memory pressure looks fine for 50% traffic. I'll watch OOM and latency spike metrics.
Sam Nguyen: i'll run the smoke and post results here. on-call: me 09:00-11:00 PT, ping @Mira Patel for escalations.
Mira Patel: thanks — please tag runs with `onboard-lite-2.0-3865432100`. if smoke passes, i'm scheduling full rollout at 09:45 PT.
dev-bot: canary started: 10% traffic -> catalog:model-lite:2.0 (canary id: cb-3865432100). logs: https://redwood.internal/logs/canary/cb-3865432100
Sam Nguyen: initial warmup looks ok, KV warming hitting ~78% after 2 minutes.
Jon Reyes: seeing small p95 bump but within bounds. no errors in the first 5m.
Sam Nguyen: smoke pass after 10m. p95=280ms, errors=0.2%. posting full output: https://redwood.internal/artifacts/smoke/3865432100
Mira Patel: great — proceeding to 50% now. if any alert fires, rollback immediately and post `rollback-trigger` with reason.
Carla Ortiz: dashboard updated and alert policy active. created #ops-aurora-lite-temp if we need rapid comms.
Sam Nguyen: 50% steady for 15m, no regressions. ready for promote. :thumbsup:
Mira Patel: promoting to 100% at 09:45 PT. final reminder: owner Sam, observers Jon & Carla. tag any anomalies here and i'll coordinate rollback.
dev-bot: rollout complete — 100% traffic -> catalog:model-lite:2.0. canary id cb-3865432100.
Jon Reyes: post-rollout quick checks done, everything green.
Sam Nguyen: all good from smoke + post-rollout checks. closing the loop. :white_check_mark:
Mira Patel: thanks team. filing the onboarding checklist and smallnotes in the model catalog metadata. if we spot anything later, open a follow-up thread.
